classSong:
We are a class of Juniors gay,
	Juniors gay,
   The highest class in school this year,
	school this year.
If it were not for us today,
   They'd have no school at all I fear.

The Freshmen and the Sophomores,
	Sophomores,
   Oh! without us what would they do,
	what would they do?
Our themes they could not copy o'er,
   And their distinctions would be few.

Chorus:
Oh, we are the learned Juniors,
   And of wisdom we've our share
Know as much as haughty Seniors,
   And our fame is rare
Praise us, praise us, kind friends, praise us,
	Praise us, praise us,
   For to our class we'll loyal be, loyal be,
And to know us there'll be a fuss,
   For Juniors, Juniors wise are we.

In logic we are wondrous wise,
	wondrous wise,
   In Cicero we never miss,
	never miss,
In Chemistry we'd take the prize,
   And writing themes, to us, is bliss.

We are the teachers' chief delight,
	chief delight,
   We always try hard them to please,
	them to please,
And strive with all our main and might
   Not like the Sophs, their trails increase.
classMotto: To thine own self be true.
name: Junior 1905
classYell:
Racketty -- rax!
Racketty -- rix!

classSong:
We Sophomores are the smartest class
   In Henderson this year.
And, that our fame won't ever last,
   We have no cause to fear.
We never miss a lesson hard,
   We never break a rule,
We have ever done things just right,
   Since we have been in school.

Chorus:
Sophomores! We are the class you know.
Sophomores! There's not one of us slow.
Sophomores! Always in my dream
I'm glad I am a Sophomore,
Instead of Freshman green.

The Juniors say we are too bold,
   But for this, we do not care.
For we aren't like them, in ways too old,
   Of fun to have our share.
The Freshmen say our hearts are stone,
   Because we call them 'green.'
But we, in this, are not alone,
   As has been seen.

Our colors! They are green and gold.
   Our motto! It's O.K.
Our yell! It shows that we are bold,
   As well as good and gay.
And though in number we are few,
   It's large enough for us.
And to our class we will be true,
   The glorious Sophomore!
name: Sophomore 1905
